hooks.description: All Bash guards: secrets, destructive, commits, deploy, migrations, deps
All Write/Edit guards: env, JWT, secrets, SHA pin, naming
All post-write guards: file size, BOM, console.log

hooks.prompt:
SESSION START — FULL INITIALIZATION.

1. ENVIRONMENT: Detect OS, machine name, working directory, shell.
2. IDENTIFY: Is this MNK-GoRin (methodology) or a project repo?
3. If project repo: run /session-start skill.
4. LOCAL vs VPS: Check hostname.
5. Windows SSH: use /c/Windows/System32/OpenSSH/ssh.exe

6. OBSIDIAN: Read the entire 01-Projets/ folder in Obsidian vault via MCP (flat structure post 2026-04-11). Load meta files (_Index.md, _Marathon-Context.md, _Infrastructure.md, _Legacy-Index.md) + every [project].md file in parallel. The old nested 02-Projets/[project]/ structure is LEGACY — do not read it.

7. EICHI: Verify Obsidian MCP is connected. If not, note it — can still read Eichi files directly.

8. REMINDERS:
- Eichi FIRST for any research
- Obsidian project notes for project state
- Run tests to check pre-existing errors
- Quality is BLOCKING, atomic commits required
- All text output in French when talking to Jay
- All files written in English
- UTF-8 without BOM always
hooks.description: Ring 1: Full environment detection + Obsidian sync + Eichi check + reminders

hooks.prompt:
CONTEXT RE-INJECTION after compaction.

Critical context that must persist:
1. CARDINAL PRINCIPLE: Code is invisible. Goal = impact on lives.
2. 4 TAKUMI ACCORDS: Impeccable Word, No Assumptions, No Ego, Always Best Effort.
3. QUALITY = BLOCKING. Zero derogation. TDG always.
4. EICHI FIRST. Search KB before web. 8 languages (EN, FR, DE, RU, ES, ZH, JA, AR).
5. OBSIDIAN PROJECT NOTES. Every session, decision, bug = Obsidian 01-Projets/[project].md (flat, one file per project, post 2026-04-11).
6. ATOMIC COMMITS. One logical change per commit. Commit = push.
7. PRE-EXISTING ERRORS: Fix them, never ignore.
8. NON-TECH AGENTS: BEFORE code (prepare) + AFTER code (validate). Not during.
9. DEBUG: LOGS FIRST. L3 = report to Jay.
10. FIX = DEPLOY on live apps.
11. Talk to Jay in French. Write all files in English. UTF-8 always.

Reload project context from Obsidian if available.

SESSION CLEARED. Full context reload needed:
1. What project? Check working directory.
2. Load Obsidian project notes: Read the entire 01-Projets/ folder via MCP (flat structure post 2026-04-11 — meta files + every [project].md).
3. Check git log -5 for recent work.
4. Run tests to check pre-existing errors.
5. Remind: Eichi first, Obsidian project notes always, Quality BLOCKING, atomic commits.
6. Talk to Jay in French. Write files in English. UTF-8 always.

SESSION RESUMED. Reload context:
1. What project are we in? Check working directory.
2. What was the last task? Check git log -5.
3. Are there uncommitted changes? Check git status.
4. Load Obsidian project notes: Read the entire 01-Projets/ folder via MCP (flat structure post 2026-04-11).
5. Remind: Eichi first, Obsidian project notes always, Quality BLOCKING, atomic commits.
6. Talk to Jay in French. Write files in English.

SESSION END — MANDATORY CHECKLIST.

1. UNCOMMITTED WORK: Are there uncommitted changes? If yes → /commit now.
2. DOCS: Were Blueprint/CDC/PET updated if code changed? If not → update now.
3. OBSIDIAN: Update 01-Projets/[project].md in Obsidian for every project touched this session (flat structure post 2026-04-11). Merge into one file per project: Notes, Décisions, Bugs, Prochaines étapes, Connexions. The old nested 02-Projets/[project]/ structure is LEGACY — never create or update there.
4. SESSION REPORT: Save to docs/Sessions/Session-YYYY-MM-DD.md
5. SCORING: Score = 100 - (violations x 10) - (warnings x 2)

Output reminders for any incomplete items. Do NOT let the session end with unfinished business.
hooks.description: Ring 1: Session end full checklist + Obsidian sync + report

hooks.prompt:
DEBUG ESCALATION CHECK. A Bash command just failed.

1. LOGS FIRST: Have the error logs been read? If hypothesizing without logs: 'RULE: LOGS FIRST. Read error output before hypothesizing.'
2. REPEATED FAILURE: Is this the 2nd+ failure on the same issue? If yes: 'WARNING: Multiple failures. Escalate: L1 (logs) → L2 (Eichi + web 8 languages) → L3 (report to Jay).'
3. CONTEXT RESET: After 2 failed corrections → suggest /clear or new conversation.
